protocol.selection: mean of target MAE / rank-median MAE, pooled across rolling validation matches
protocol.external_policy: Legacy pro/ranked sets are descriptive only; fresh holdout is evaluated once after selection.
limitations: Economy forecasts describe associations, not causal impact or optimal actions.
Only complete games lasting at least twenty minutes are represented.
Farm rank at minute ten is not an independently verified playing position.

uncertainty.limitation: Descriptive bands from the same development CV used for selection; not an independent conformal calibration or coverage guarantee.

selection.selection_scope: original development matches only; no external evaluations used

receipt.release_gate: Winner fixed by development CV; promote only if every target MAE is lower than legacy ridge on fresh ranked games, with at least 50 eligible games.

release_gate.criterion: Winner fixed by development CV; promote only if every target MAE is lower than legacy ridge on fresh ranked games, with at least 50 eligible games.

limitations: Fresh ranked games are a narrow time-window convenience sample from one patch.
Only five eligible future professional games were available; those scores are exploratory.
Legacy benchmarks were already inspected previously and are descriptive.
Strict fresh no-disconnect selection differs from the older corpus.
No causal impact, best action or improvement in player MMR was measured.
